summary.name: AltoRank
summary.one_liner: AltoRank is an open-source SEO content workspace that combines keyword research, AI article drafting with sources, and editorial review, available hosted or self-hosted.
use_cases: Researching buyer questions and choosing article topics
Drafting sourced SEO articles from a brief
Keeping a consistent brand voice across content
Tracking search performance and site visits after publishing
Managing content for multiple clients in separate workspaces
summary.what_it_does: AltoRank helps plan content by researching topics and comparing search results against a business, audience and market. It generates structured article drafts with sources and internal links that the user reviews, edits and approves before export or arranged publishing. A voice profile can be built from existing published writing to guide tone and language. It can connect Search Console and GA4 to show search performance and visits in the same workspace. The page also describes an AI Readability Report that runs nine technical checks on websites.
notable: Open source engine that can be self-hosted with your own API keys at no subscription fee
Includes an MCP server to drive it from Claude Code
Brand voice profile built from your published writing
Connects Google Search Console and GA4 for performance tracking
caveats: Hosted Managed plan is €69/month and Agency is €199/month after a 7-day card trial; self-hosting means paying your own infrastructure and API costs
Publishing to CMS platforms is currently assisted and availability varies by platform; you can also export HTML or Markdown
Paid plan required to approve and publish through the hosted app; the page does not guarantee rankings or traffic
